profile.headline: Staff Machine Learning Engineer at Google (YouTube Music)
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a Machine Learning Engineer working on the ranking and recommendation systems that power the YouTube Music home page.

Before this, I worked on Friend Stories ranking as well as computer vision and ranking for fashion similarity search at Snap Inc. in NY.

I previously worked at Facebook NY from 2015 to 2019.

Prior to that, I completed my PhD at Cornell University under the advisement of Professor Thorsten Joachims. See my CV for a list of publications.

Specialties: Machine learning, search ranking, recommendation systems, information retrieval, music information retrieval, optimization.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Tech lead on YouTube Music home ranking.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
In my first four years at Snapchat, I worked on the Perception team, which supported the Scan (visual search) feature. I was the first engineer on our fashion scan project, where I designed and built out our initial system. This feature allows a user to scan an image of an outfit or clothing item to get visually and stylistically similar fashion items for shopping intents. In addition to the scan surface, this feature was expanded to the Memories and Stories surfaces in the app. As the project grew, I became a tech lead for a team of engineers driving improvements in the fashion similarity models and retrieval systems powering this feature.

In October 2023, I moved to the Stories Ranking team. On this team, I led engineers and made improvements to our ranking models for Friend Stories Ranking. I also built out and improved our team's systems for applying Bayesian Optimization, both offline in model training (hyperparameter sweeps) and online for value model tuning. These systems were also used in other Content verticals such as Spotlight and the Discover Feed.

positions.title: Research Scientist
positions.description:
Here's some of the work I've done at Facebook:

- Core ML: Built out infrastructure for feature selection and feature importance logging, as well as improvements to a parameter sweep workflow used throughout the company

- Local Search Infrastructure: Led ML efforts for search ranking in places search. Launched the team’s first ML model for categorical searches. Developed refinements for ranking and filtering models that drove constant gains in recall and CTR. Built out infrastructure streamlining model publishing process to almost zero manual effort (push button), which was adopted by dozens of engineers in the search org. Integrated a widely used measurement platform with a common ML platform, yielding a workflow used by dozens of engineers outside the team.

- Trust in AI: Led the team’s engineering efforts for building out tooling measuring fairness in ML models. Integrated that measurement platform with a frequently used ML platform. Collaborated directly with integrity teams on measuring and correcting unfairness in ML models. Led an intern project building out monitoring and logging infrastructure for our tooling which was adopted by partner teams.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Search learning group. Implemented new training routines for learning ranking models for various areas of search around the website, leading to improved search performance and new model types for use by other employees.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Research on natural language processing tasks with Christopher J. C. Burges. Short paper presented at EMNLP 2013: Animacy Detection with Voting Models, J. L. Moore, C. J. C. Burges, E. Renshaw, W. T. Yih.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern in Research
positions.description: Machine learning research relating to YouTube and Google Music.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with machine learning methods in Google Maps.

positions.title: Werkstudent - Corporate Technology
positions.description: Student Intern and research assistant. Researched random walk based distance measures for similarity-based querying in graphs for the semantic web. Developed in a team a piece of software dealing with the smart grid.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Conducted research in computer vision and machine learning, including coding, experiment design and execution. Advised by Prof. James M. Rehg.

positions.title: Studentische Hilfskraft
positions.description: Assisted in implementing and testing image segmentation algorithms to be deployed in a multi-view 3D reconstruction system. Worked with doctoral student Alexander Ladikos in Prof. Dr. Nassir Navab's CAMPAR group.

honors.title: Best Student Paper Award
honors.description: Best Student Paper award for "Taste Space Versus the World: an Embedding Analysis of Listening Habits and Geography."
